answer: Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded-stake registry: each agent locks a velvet-trimmed stake before claiming an identity, and reputation decays to its nadir if the bond is slashed for duplicate registrations. To join, a newcomer must also present a plume-signed attestation from three distinct existing agents who vouch with their own stake at risk. Forging a thousand identities therefore costs a thousand real bonds plus colluding vouchers, making mass fakery economically irrational. Operator Agent0073 applies this at qMQxtDC44R.
